ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge timing used to sample ROM data and request control; it sequences rdata and rden updates on each clock edge.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) used in mem_access and bus_feedback processes.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Asserts synchronous reset behaviour for rden: when '0' it forces rden to '0' overriding normal updates; used only to reset internal read-enable state.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then rden <= '0' in bus_feedback process.

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Supplies address and control fields to the ROM logic; its addr field selects which ROM word rdata captures and its stb/rw fields compute the sampled read enable rden.
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.addr indexed in mem_access assignment; bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw used in bus_feedback assignment to rden.

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Provides the word address bits used to index mem_rom_c; the selected ROM word is captured into rdata on the clock edge.
role: selects ROM word captured into rdata

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the request bundle but not referenced anywhere in this source; it is not read or forwarded here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_t.data is declared in the port list but never used in any assignment or condition.

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the request bundle but not referenced in this entity; it is not read or acted on here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_t.ben is present in port list with no uses in processes or assignments.

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Sampled on the clock and combined with rw to form rden; its sampled value contributes directly to the internal read-enable register.
ports.evidence: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) inside rising_edge(clk_i) in bus_feedback process.

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Used (negated) together with stb to compute the sampled read-enable rden; its value on the rising edge contributes to rden.
ports.evidence: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) inside bus_feedback process.

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared in the request bundle but not read or forwarded by this entity; it plays no role in the ROM response logic here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_t.src present in port list with no references in the architecture.

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Part of the request bundle but not inspected or propagated in this source; it is not used to decide any behaviour here.
ports.evidence: No uses of bus_req_i.priv in any assignment or condition in the entity.

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared but not consumed or forwarded inside this entity; it does not affect ROM access or responses here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.debug appears only in the port declaration and is not referenced elsewhere.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Included in the request record but not used by the ROM logic; it is not read or forwarded in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.amo in this file.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Part of the request bundle but not referenced in the ROM; it is unused by the entity's logic.
ports.evidence: Declared in port list with no further references in architecture.

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Provided in the request record but not consulted by this ROM entity; it has no effect here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.lock is never read in the source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Part of the request bundle but not used by this entity; it is not checked or forwarded.
ports.evidence: No uses of bus_req_i.fence in the entity source.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Drives the response fields to the bus master: data is produced from rdata (when enabled), ack mirrors rden, and err is driven '0'.
ports.evidence: Assignments: bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0'); bus_rsp_o.ack <= rden; bus_rsp_o.err <= '0'.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Driven directly from the internal rden register on assignment; reports the sampled read-enable back to the bus master.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= rden; direct assignment in architecture.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Always driven to '0' and presented to the bus master; it does not depend on any internal declared signal.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Outputs the captured ROM word (rdata) when the sampled read-enable rden is '1', otherwise drives zeros; thus it is derived from rdata and qualified by rden.
role: carries ROM read result when enabled
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0') in concurrent assignment.

signals.name: rden
signals.functionality: Holds the sampled read-enable value captured from bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw on the rising clock; reset drives it to '0'. It gates the data output and is reflected to ack.
signals.evidence: bus_feedback process: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) on rising_edge(clk_i); rden used in bus_rsp_o.data condition and assigned to bus_rsp_o.ack.

signals.name: rdata
signals.functionality: Captures the ROM word selected by bus_req_i.addr on the clock edge and supplies that word to bus_rsp_o.data when enabled by rden.
signals.evidence: mem_access process: rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(boot_rom_size_index_c+1 downto 2)))) and rdata used in bus_rsp_o.data assignment.
